entries.remaining_substantive_scope: Definition requires (weight loss OR age-specific BMI) AND causal disease/trauma AND reduced intake/absorption, plus diet/bariatric exclusions, dosing and report details. D46 and followup-v2 encode these only as narrative. Later enteral packet is a separate authority; coordinate rather than duplicate.

Actual body 4.2.9.A-2#17efb08b requires initiation Hb<11 g/dl AND blasts<5% AND serum EPO<500 mu/ml; stop above Hb12, alpha/beta weekly cap900 IU/kg, report/prescriber/hemogram details. D46/followup-v2 has no marker or typed numeric checks. Confirm active drug identities against struck DOCX text before retaining darbepoetin brand aliases.
